lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How many people signed up so far?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I haven't done a full tally yet, but it looks like around forty.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Did the final numbers match what we expected?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Not quite. The expenses don't fully tally with the receipts we collected.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: When should we count the votes?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Let's do the tally on Monday evening after everyone has submitted their ballots.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Are you keeping track of the scores?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yeah, I've been making a running tally on my phone.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The inventory count feels off.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You're right. The physical stock doesn't tally with what's in the system.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How many hours did you work this week?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I'll tally them up later tonight and send you the total.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Did the donations reach the goal?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Almost. The current tally is just under the target.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Why do the two lists look different?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Because the names don't completely tally. A few people are missing from one side.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Should we update the spreadsheet now?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Better to wait until the end of the day so we can tally everything at once.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Any idea how many tickets we sold?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Not exactly. I'll do a proper tally tomorrow morning and let you know.
